# Lexical Form Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](gmeow-LexicalFormType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LexicalFormType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a lexical form — a value, never an [`Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) subclass. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence; new analytical frameworks may introduce further form types without ontology modification.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](gmeow-LexicalFormType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the lexical-form-kind axis — the seeded modalities (written, spoken, signed, reconstructed, …) referenced from a form via [`gmeow:formType`](../properties/gmeow-formType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid creating per-kind subclasses (kinds are individuals) and avoid using it for the form itself (that is [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](gmeow-LexicalForm.md)).

### How to use

- Reference the seeded form-type individuals from a form; extend the axis for a new analytical framework by minting a fresh [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](gmeow-LexicalFormType.md) individual rather than a subclass.

### Examples

- ex:formGlossed a [`gmeow:LexicalFormType`](gmeow-LexicalFormType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "glossed"@en.
